bugs.error_message: Native traffic lights render in their own titlebar strip above the web titlebar instead of inline with it

Note: tao's inset_traffic_lights applies y minus the button's ~9pt offset inside the native container, so config y:25 yields visual top 16pt / center 23pt (centered in 46px titlebar). Web titlebar uses padding-left:13px + 52px traffic-spacer.

bugs.root_cause: Old stored contentWidth 860/1080 and fontSize 24 passed through load() unmodified; new UI presets (560/680/820/9999, slider 14-22) couldn't represent them, so the width control showed no selection and the slider clamped

bugs.error_message: stripJsonc corrupts string values containing ',]' or ',}' when removing trailing commas
bugs.root_cause: Trailing-comma removal used a global regex /,(\s*[}\]])/g over the whole comment-stripped text, including inside string literals, so a theme value like "foo,]" was mangled.
bugs.fix: Strip the trailing comma inside the string-aware char loop: when outside a string and the char is '}' or ']', drop a preceding comma via out.replace(/,(\s*)$/, '$1'). Commas inside string values are emitted in the in-string branch and never touched. Added a regression test.
